Advantages:
- Avoids most of the N-1 truncation complexity and special case issues that introduces
    - For example related to prompt logprobs
- Avoids redundant computation of last prompt token on D
- Avoids need for MM encoding on D side (cases where we would back-off into image tokens)
    - Which could otherwise impact ITL
    - Can avoid loading mm encoder weights on D for more kv cache capacity
- Preserves target model uniform decode full cuda graphs in multi-module MTP case (which otherwise recompute k-1 prompt tokens)
- Consistency across model/attention types

This implementation stashes the final hidden states (including aux layers and extra positions for eagle3 / multi-module mtp) into kvcache token slots past the end of the prompt. This means:
- Usually zero additional memory or transfer overhead (uses existing block padding)
- Simpler code - we can piggy-back on much of the existing lifecycle logic without needing an additional custom buffer with it's own slot management and nixl registration
- Existing connectors with HMA support need minimal changes

This is tested and working with NIXL, including push/pull and hetero TP. Compatibility with the following will require some additional changes: CP, nixl host-buffer mode, HiSparse. Other P/D connectors also not yet tested.

Thanks to @Dao007forever and @ivanium for help with these ideas.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Scheduler flow of the P/D hidden-state handoff."""
+
+import copy
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+    FullAttentionSpec,
+    KVCacheConfig,
+    KVCacheGroupSpec,
+)
+from vllm.v1.outputs import EMPTY_MODEL_RUNNER_OUTPUT, KVConnectorOutput
+from vllm.v1.request import RequestStatus
+
+from .utils import (
+    create_model_runner_output,
+    create_request,
+    create_scheduler,
+)
+from .utils import create_vllm_config as _create_vllm_config
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.cpu_test
+
+
+def create_vllm_config(**kwargs):
+    # The handoff does not support NIXL host buffers, the default on CPU
+    # platforms; where NIXL buffers live does not matter to these tests.
+    kwargs.setdefault("kv_buffer_device", "cuda")
+    return _create_vllm_config(**kwargs)
+
+
+# opt-125m: a 768-wide fp16 hidden state, 1536 bytes, stored as 3072 (a nibble
+# per byte). Each token slot holds (96 + 96) * 2 bytes per head per layer, 768
+# over the two layers.
+TAIL_TOKENS = 4
+
+
+def _config(block_size):
+    return KVCacheConfig(
+        num_blocks=1000,
+        kv_cache_tensors=[],
+        kv_cache_groups=[
+            KVCacheGroupSpec(
+                ["layer0", "layer1"],
+                FullAttentionSpec(
+                    block_size=block_size,
+                    num_kv_heads=2,
+                    head_size=96,
+                    dtype=torch.float16,
+                ),
+            ),
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+def _make(kv_role="kv_consumer"):
+    vllm_config = create_vllm_config(
+        kv_connector_extra_config={"hidden_state_handoff": True},
+        kv_role=kv_role,
+        kv_load_failure_policy="recompute",
+    )
+    bs = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+    scheduler = create_scheduler(vllm_config, kv_cache_config=_config(bs))
+    assert scheduler.hidden_state_record_group_id == 0
+    assert scheduler.hidden_state_record_tail_tokens == TAIL_TOKENS
+    return vllm_config, scheduler
+
+
+def _num_blocks(scheduler, request):
+    return len(scheduler.kv_cache_manager.get_block_ids(request.request_id)[0])
+
+
+def _recv(scheduler, request, failed=False):
+    so = scheduler.schedule()
+    assert request.status == RequestStatus.WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS
+    out = copy.deepcopy(EMPTY_MODEL_RUNNER_OUTPUT)
+    out.kv_connector_output = KVConnectorOutput(
+        finished_recving={request.request_id},
+        failed_recving={request.request_id} if failed else set(),
+    )
+    scheduler.update_from_output(so, out)
+
+
+def test_decode_samples_from_record():
+    """D loads the prompt's blocks plus those of the record's slots past the
+    prompt, then samples the last prompt token from the record."""
+    vllm_config, scheduler = _make()
+    bs = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+    # The record fits the last block, starts a new one, or spills into one.
+    for num_tokens in (bs * 2 + 5, bs * 2, bs * 2 + bs - 1):
+        request = create_request(
+            block_size=bs,
+            num_tokens=num_tokens,
+            do_remote_prefill=True,
+            num_remote_blocks=3,
+        )
+        scheduler.add_request(request)
+        _recv(scheduler, request)
+        assert _num_blocks(scheduler, request) == cdiv(num_tokens + TAIL_TOKENS, bs)
+        so = scheduler.schedule()
+        rid = request.request_id
+        assert so.hidden_state_record_req_ids == {rid}
+        assert so.num_scheduled_tokens[rid] == 1
+        (new_req,) = so.scheduled_new_reqs
+        assert new_req.num_computed_tokens == num_tokens - 1
+        scheduler.update_from_output(so, create_model_runner_output([request]))
+        so = scheduler.schedule()
+        assert not so.hidden_state_record_req_ids
+        assert request.num_computed_tokens == num_tokens + 1
+        scheduler.finish_requests(rid, RequestStatus.FINISHED_ABORTED)
+        scheduler.update_from_output(so, create_model_runner_output([]))
+
+
+def test_record_blocks_not_zeroed_under_load():
+    """Blocks the load writes the record into are not zeroed under it."""
+    vllm_config, scheduler = _make()
+    bs = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+    scheduler.needs_kv_cache_zeroing = True
+    for manager in scheduler.kv_cache_manager.coordinator.single_type_managers:
+        manager._record_new_block_ids = True
+    # The record starts a block past the prompt's.
+    request = create_request(
+        block_size=bs, num_tokens=bs * 2, do_remote_prefill=True, num_remote_blocks=3
+    )
+    scheduler.add_request(request)
+    so = scheduler.schedule()
+    assert request.status == RequestStatus.WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS
+    assert _num_blocks(scheduler, request) == 3
+    assert not so.new_block_ids_to_zero
+
+
+def test_failed_recv_recomputes():
+    vllm_config, scheduler = _make()
+    bs = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+    request = create_request(
+        block_size=bs, num_tokens=bs * 2 + 3, do_remote_prefill=True
+    )
+    scheduler.add_request(request)
+    _recv(scheduler, request, failed=True)
+    so = scheduler.schedule()
+    assert not so.hidden_state_record_req_ids
+    assert so.num_scheduled_tokens[request.request_id] > 1
+
+
+def test_prefiller_hands_over_record_blocks():
+    """P reserves the record's slots past the prompt and hands over their
+    blocks with the prompt's."""
+    vllm_config, scheduler = _make(kv_role="kv_producer")
+    bs = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+    for num_tokens in (bs * 2 + 3, bs * 2, bs * 2 + bs - 1):
+        request = create_request(
+            block_size=bs, num_tokens=num_tokens, do_remote_decode=True
+        )
+        scheduler.add_request(request)
+        so = scheduler.schedule()
+        assert so.num_scheduled_tokens[request.request_id] == num_tokens
+        outs = scheduler.update_from_output(
+            so, create_model_runner_output([request], use_eos=True)
+        )
+        params = outs[0].outputs[0].kv_transfer_params
+        (remote_block_ids,) = params["remote_block_ids"]
+        assert len(remote_block_ids) == cdiv(num_tokens + TAIL_TOKENS, bs)
+
+
+def test_local_request_reserves_no_record():
+    vllm_config, scheduler = _make(kv_role="kv_producer")
+    bs = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+    request = create_request(block_size=bs, num_tokens=bs * 2)
+    scheduler.add_request(request)
+    scheduler.schedule()
+    assert _num_blocks(scheduler, request) == 2
+
+
+def test_record_carrier_group():
+    """A full-attention group carries the record if there is one, else a
+    sliding-window one; ring buffers and compressed caches cannot."""
+    from vllm.v1.core.hidden_state_record import get_record_carrier_group
+    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+        CircularBufferSpec,
+        MLAAttentionSpec,
+        RSWASpec,
+        SlidingWindowSpec,
+    )
+
+    common = dict(block_size=16, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=8, dtype=torch.float16)
+    full = FullAttentionSpec(**common)
+    swa = SlidingWindowSpec(**common, sliding_window=64)
+    rswa = RSWASpec(**common, rswa_window=64)
+    ring = CircularBufferSpec(**common)
+    compressed = MLAAttentionSpec(**common, tokens_per_state=4)
+
+    def carrier(*specs):
+        return get_record_carrier_group(
+            KVCacheConfig(
+                num_blocks=10,
+                kv_cache_tensors=[],
+                kv_cache_groups=[
+                    KVCacheGroupSpec([f"layer{i}"], spec)
+                    for i, spec in enumerate(specs)
+                ],
+            )
+        )
+
+    assert carrier(swa, full) == 1
+    assert carrier(compressed, swa, ring) == 1
+    assert carrier(rswa, swa) == 0
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError):
+        carrier(compressed, ring)
+
+
+def test_sliding_window_clip_covers_record_tail():
+    """NIXL hands over a sliding-window group's last blocks; with the handoff
+    they also cover the record's slots past the prompt."""
+    from .utils import make_kv_cache_config
+
+    vllm_config = create_vllm_config(
+        kv_connector_extra_config={"hidden_state_handoff": True},
+        kv_role="kv_producer",
+    )
+    bs = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+    kv_cache_config = make_kv_cache_config(bs, swa_enabled=True, sw_size=128)
+    scheduler = create_scheduler(vllm_config, kv_cache_config=kv_cache_config)
+    tail = scheduler.hidden_state_record_tail_tokens
+    # Full group: (16 + 16) * 2 bytes per head, two layers; 3072 stored bytes.
+    assert tail == 24
+    blocks_per_sw = scheduler.connector.connector_scheduler.blocks_per_sw
+    assert blocks_per_sw == [0, cdiv(128 + tail, bs) + 1]
+
+
+def test_sliding_window_carrier_hands_over_record_blocks():
+    """Without a full-attention group, a sliding-window group carries the
+    record: P hands over its window's last blocks, through the record's."""
+    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import SlidingWindowSpec
+
+    vllm_config = create_vllm_config(
+        kv_connector_extra_config={"hidden_state_handoff": True},
+        kv_role="kv_producer",
+    )
+    bs = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+    window = 2 * bs
+    kv_cache_config = KVCacheConfig(
+        num_blocks=1000,
+        kv_cache_tensors=[],
+        kv_cache_groups=[
+            KVCacheGroupSpec(
+                ["layer0", "layer1"],
+                SlidingWindowSpec(
+                    block_size=bs,
+                    num_kv_heads=2,
+                    head_size=96,
+                    dtype=torch.float16,
+                    sliding_window=window,
+                ),
+            ),
+        ],
+    )
+    scheduler = create_scheduler(vllm_config, kv_cache_config=kv_cache_config)
+    assert scheduler.hidden_state_record_group_id == 0
+    assert scheduler.hidden_state_record_tail_tokens == TAIL_TOKENS
+    num_tokens = 3 * bs + bs - 1
+    request = create_request(
+        block_size=bs, num_tokens=num_tokens, do_remote_decode=True
+    )
+    scheduler.add_request(request)
+    so = scheduler.schedule()
+    assert so.num_scheduled_tokens[request.request_id] == num_tokens
+    outs = scheduler.update_from_output(
+        so, create_model_runner_output([request], use_eos=True)
+    )
+    (remote_block_ids,) = outs[0].outputs[0].kv_transfer_params["remote_block_ids"]
+    # The window's last blocks, ending with the one holding the record's end.
+    n_sw = cdiv(window + TAIL_TOKENS, bs) + 1
+    assert len(remote_block_ids) == n_sw
+    blocks = scheduler.kv_cache_manager.get_block_ids(request.request_id)[0]
+    last_record_block = (num_tokens + TAIL_TOKENS - 1) // bs
+    assert remote_block_ids[-1] == blocks[last_record_block] != 0
+
+
+def test_record_size_agrees_with_mixed_layer_sizes():
+    """The scheduler's config keeps one spec per group, so the record's size
+    comes from the per-layer specs resolved into the config: the scheduler and
+    the workers reserve and use the same slots."""
+    from vllm.v1.core.hidden_state_record import (
+        get_record_layers,
+        get_record_tail_tokens,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_utils import generate_scheduler_kv_cache_config
+    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs
+
+    vllm_config = create_vllm_config(
+        kv_connector_extra_config={"hidden_state_handoff": True}
+    )
+    bs = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+    specs = {
+        f"layer{i}": FullAttentionSpec(
+            block_size=bs, num_kv_heads=2, head_size=head_size, dtype=torch.float16
+        )
+        for i, head_size in enumerate((32, 96, 96))
+    }
+    group_spec = UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs.from_specs(specs)
+    assert group_spec is not None
+    worker_config = KVCacheConfig(
+        num_blocks=1000,
+        kv_cache_tensors=[],
+        kv_cache_groups=[KVCacheGroupSpec(list(specs), group_spec)],
+    )
+    # (32 + 32) * 2 + 2 * (96 + 96) * 2 bytes per token slot.
+    assert sum(size for _, size in get_record_layers(worker_config)) == 896
+    worker_tail = get_record_tail_tokens(vllm_config, worker_config)
+    assert worker_tail == cdiv(3072, 896)
+
+    # Without the resolved layers, the scheduler's one spec per group would
+    # size it as three 128-byte layers.
+    unresolved = generate_scheduler_kv_cache_config([worker_config])
+    assert get_record_tail_tokens(vllm_config, unresolved) == cdiv(3072, 384)
+
+    worker_config.hidden_state_record_layers = get_record_layers(worker_config)
+    scheduler_config = generate_scheduler_kv_cache_config([worker_config])
+    assert get_record_tail_tokens(vllm_config, scheduler_config) == worker_tail
+
+
+def _layers_config(block_size, layers):
+    return KVCacheConfig(
+        num_blocks=1000,
+        kv_cache_tensors=[],
+        kv_cache_groups=[
+            KVCacheGroupSpec(
+                [f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn" for i in layers],
+                FullAttentionSpec(
+                    block_size=block_size,
+                    num_kv_heads=2,
+                    head_size=96,
+                    dtype=torch.float16,
+                ),
+            ),
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("pp_size", [1, 2, 3])
+def test_record_layers_of_pipelined_prefiller(pp_size):
+    """A prefiller with PP keeps the records in its last stage's layers; a
+    decoder configured with the prefiller's PP size reads them there."""
+    from vllm.v1.core.hidden_state_record import (
+        get_record_tail_tokens,
+        resolve_record_layers,
+    )
+
+    p_config = create_vllm_config(
+        kv_connector_extra_config={"hidden_state_handoff": True},
+        kv_role="kv_producer",
+    )
+    p_config.parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size = pp_size
+    d_config = create_vllm_config(
+        kv_connector_extra_config={
+            "hidden_state_handoff": True,
+            "hidden_state_handoff_producer_pp_size": pp_size,
+        },
+        kv_role="kv_consumer",
+    )
+    bs = p_config.cache_config.block_size
+    # opt-125m has 12 layers: P's per-stage worker configs, D's single one.
+    stages = [
+        list(range(12))[stage * 12 // pp_size : (stage + 1) * 12 // pp_size]
+        for stage in range(pp_size)
+    ]
+    p_layers = resolve_record_layers(
+        p_config, [_layers_config(bs, stage) for stage in stages]
+    )
+    d_layers = resolve_record_layers(d_config, [_layers_config(bs, range(12))])
+    last_stage = {1: range(12), 2: range(6, 12), 3: range(8, 12)}[pp_size]
+    assert (
+        p_layers
+        == d_layers
+        == tuple((f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn", 384) for i in last_stage)
+    )
+    # 3072 stored bytes, 384 per layer and token slot.
+    d_kv_cache_config = _layers_config(bs, range(12))
+    d_kv_cache_config.hidden_state_record_layers = d_layers
+    assert get_record_tail_tokens(d_config, d_kv_cache_config) == cdiv(
+        3072, 384 * len(last_stage)
+    )
+
+
+def test_handoff_on_by_default_where_supported(monkeypatch):
+    """With NIXL as producer or consumer the handoff is on unless configured
+    off; elsewhere it stays off; one-sided unsupported features are errors."""
+    from vllm.v1.core.hidden_state_record import resolve_hidden_state_handoff
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")
+
+    def resolved(**kwargs):
+        # An empty extra config leaves the handoff to its default.
+        kwargs.setdefault("kv_connector_extra_config", {})
+        vllm_config = create_vllm_config(**kwargs)
+        assert vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None
+        return vllm_config.kv_transfer_config.hidden_state_handoff
+
+    assert resolved(kv_role="kv_producer")
+    assert resolved(kv_role="kv_consumer")
+    assert not resolved(kv_role="kv_both")
+    assert not resolved(
+        kv_role="kv_consumer",
+        kv_connector_extra_config={"hidden_state_handoff": False},
+    )
+
+    vllm_config = create_vllm_config(
+        kv_role="kv_consumer", kv_connector_extra_config={}
+    )
+    assert vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None
+    extra_config = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config.kv_connector_extra_config
+    del extra_config["hidden_state_handoff"]
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "0")
+    resolve_hidden_state_handoff(vllm_config)
+    assert extra_config["hidden_state_handoff"] is False
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")
+    del extra_config["hidden_state_handoff"]
+    vllm_config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size = 2
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="decode context parallelism"):
+        resolve_hidden_state_handoff(vllm_config)

+"""Kernels of the P/D hidden-state handoff: records into and out of the KV
+cache slots past the prompt, and the sample-only rows appended to a batch."""

+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+from vllm.v1.core.hidden_state_record import RecordLayout

+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="needs CUDA")

+DEVICE = torch.device("cuda")
+BLOCK_SIZE = 4
+MAX_REQS = 8

+
+def _handoff(
+    layout: RecordLayout, num_blocks: int = 48, num_heads: int = 2, split: int = 1
+):
+    """A handoff over two fp16 layers' [blocks, heads, tokens, K + V] caches
+    of different head sizes, with each request's blocks scattered. Each block
+    of the block table is ``split`` of the caches' (kernel) blocks."""
+    caches = [
+        torch.zeros(
+            num_blocks,
+            num_heads,
+            BLOCK_SIZE,
+            2 * size,
+            dtype=torch.float16,
+            device=DEVICE,
+        )
+        for size in (8, 4)
+    ]
+    handoff = object.__new__(HiddenStateHandoff)
+    handoff.device = DEVICE
+    handoff.dtype = torch.float16
+    handoff.layout = layout
+    handoff.record_bytes = layout.num_slots * layout.hidden_size * 2
+    views = [cache.view(torch.uint8) for cache in caches]
+    handoff.head_bytes = sum(v.shape[-1] for v in views)
+    handoff.tail_tokens = cdiv(2 * handoff.record_bytes, handoff.head_bytes)
+    perm = torch.randperm(
+        num_blocks // split, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    )
+    block_table = perm.view(MAX_REQS, -1).to(torch.int32).to(DEVICE)
+    handoff._init_record_slots(views, block_table, split * BLOCK_SIZE, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    return handoff, caches, block_table
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("split", [1, 2])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_heads_read", [2, 1])
+def test_record_round_trip_through_kv_slots(num_heads_read, split):
+    """Records written past the prompt into every KV head read back whole,
+    also from a head slice (a decoder at a different TP size), laid out one
+    nibble per byte, split over the layers of each token slot, also with the
+    block table's blocks split into kernel blocks."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    layout = RecordLayout(hidden_size=24, window=1, num_aux=2)
+    handoff, caches, block_table = _handoff(layout, split=split)
+    # 192 bytes, stored as 384, at 48 per token slot.
+    assert handoff.tail_tokens == 8
+
+    req_idx = torch.tensor([1, 4, 6], dtype=torch.int64, device=DEVICE)
+    prompt_len = torch.tensor([3, 9, 4], dtype=torch.int64, device=DEVICE)
+    records = torch.randn(3, layout.num_slots, layout.hidden_size).half().to(DEVICE)
+    handoff._write_records(req_idx, prompt_len, records.view(3, -1).view(torch.uint8))
+
+    payload = records.view(3, -1).view(torch.uint8)
+    encoded = torch.stack([payload & 0xF, payload >> 4], dim=-1).view(3, -1)
+    expected = encoded.view(3, handoff.tail_tokens, handoff.head_bytes)
+    written = torch.zeros(len(caches), *caches[0].shape[:3], dtype=torch.bool)
+    for r, (req, n) in enumerate(zip(req_idx.tolist(), prompt_len.tolist())):
+        start = 0
+        for layer, cache in enumerate(caches):
+            view = cache.view(torch.uint8)
+            size = view.shape[-1]
+            for t in range(handoff.tail_tokens):
+                pos = n + t
+                block = int(block_table[req, pos // (split * BLOCK_SIZE)])
+                block = block * split + pos % (split * BLOCK_SIZE) // BLOCK_SIZE
+                offset = pos % BLOCK_SIZE
+                written[layer, block, :, offset] = True
+                want = expected[r, t, start : start + size]
+                assert torch.equal(view[block, :, offset], want.expand(2, -1))
+            start += size
+    for layer, cache in enumerate(caches):
+        # No other token slot is touched (the prompts' included).
+        assert not cache.view(torch.uint8)[~written[layer].to(DEVICE)].any()
+
+    if num_heads_read == 1:
+        handoff._init_record_slots(
+            [cache.view(torch.uint8)[:, 1:] for cache in caches],
+            block_table,
+            split * BLOCK_SIZE,
+            BLOCK_SIZE,
+        )
+    assert torch.equal(handoff._read_records(req_idx, prompt_len), records)

+def test_save_gathers_records():
+    """A completed prompt's record holds the model output at its last position
+    and each drafter input at the window's positions, right-aligned (zeros
+    before the prompt's start); unfinished and decode rows save none."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    layout = RecordLayout(hidden_size=24, window=2, num_aux=1)
+    handoff, _, _ = _handoff(layout)
+    handoff.saves_records = True
+    handoff.group_id = 0
+    handoff.block_tables = SimpleNamespace(
+        num_blocks=SimpleNamespace(np=np.full((1, MAX_REQS), 6, dtype=np.int32))
+    )
+    # Rows: a whole 5-token prompt, a decode, a prompt's final chunk (tokens
+    # 4..8 of 9), a 1-token prompt and an unfinished chunk (tokens 0..2 of 9).
+    num_scheduled = np.array([5, 1, 5, 1, 3], dtype=np.int32)
+    query_start_loc = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(num_scheduled)])
+    prefill_len = np.array([5, 4, 9, 1, 9], dtype=np.int32)
+    num_computed = np.array([0, 4, 4, 0, 0], dtype=np.int32)
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(
+        num_reqs=5,
+        idx_mapping_np=np.array([3, 0, 5, 2, 7]),
+        num_scheduled_tokens=num_scheduled,
+        query_start_loc_np=query_start_loc,
+        prefill_len_np=prefill_len,
+        num_computed_prefill_tokens_np=num_computed,
+        is_prefilling_np=num_computed < prefill_len,
+    )
+    num_tokens = int(query_start_loc[-1])
+    hidden, drafter, aux = (
+        torch.randn(num_tokens, 24).half().to(DEVICE) for _ in range(3)
+    )
+    handoff._save(batch, hidden, drafter, [aux])

+    req_idx, prompt_len, records = handoff._pending

+    assert prompt_len.tolist() == [5, 9, 1]
+    records = records.view(torch.float16).view(3, layout.num_slots, 24)
+    zero = torch.zeros(24, dtype=torch.float16, device=DEVICE)
+    # Last prompt token: row 0's token 4, row 2's token 6 + 4, row 3's 11.
+    for r, last in enumerate([4, 10, 11]):

+        assert torch.equal(records[r, 3], aux[last - 1] if before else zero)
+        assert torch.equal(records[r, 4], aux[last])

+def _decoder_handoff(layout: RecordLayout, decode_query_len: int):
+    handoff = object.__new__(HiddenStateHandoff)
+    handoff.device = DEVICE
+    handoff.dtype = torch.float16
+    handoff.layout = layout

+    )
+    handoff.model = SimpleNamespace()

+    token_ids = 1000 * torch.arange(MAX_REQS)[:, None] + torch.arange(32)[None, :]

+"""Where the P/D hidden-state handoff keeps its record (prototype).
+
+The prefiller (P) hands the decoder (D) a per-request "record" of hidden states
+from the last prompt positions (see ``RecordLayout`` and
+``vllm.v1.worker.gpu.hidden_state_handoff``). It travels in the request's own
+KV blocks: in the token slots just past the prompt, ``N .. N + tail - 1`` for an
+``N``-token prompt, of one attention cache group (the "carrier"): a
+full-attention group if there is one, else a sliding-window group (whose newest
+blocks, covering the slots past the prompt, are kept and transferred).
+
+Those slots are free on both sides when the record is written and read: P
+writes the record once its last step is done (the request then finishes), and D
+reads it in the step that samples token ``N``, before its first decode step
+writes slot ``N``. The scheduler reserves the ``tail`` slots past the prompt on
+both sides and P hands over the blocks covering them, so any connector that
+transfers whole blocks carries the record with the KV.
+
+Each slot holds the record bytes in every KV head (one copy per head), so a
+decoder at a different TP size, which receives a different head slice of each
+block, still finds a whole record in each of its heads.
+
+The slots past the prompt are unused KV as far as attention is concerned, but
+kernels may still load them (masked), and blocks are reused with their contents.
+So each record byte is stored as two bytes holding a nibble each (0x0 - 0xF),
+which read as small finite values in any KV cache format (including FP8 and
+scale bytes), never as NaN or Inf.

+# Auxiliary hidden-state layers the target captures for an EAGLE3-style
+# drafter when the drafter config names none (models' default).
+_DEFAULT_NUM_AUX_LAYERS = 3
+
+# Stored bytes per record byte (one nibble each; see the module docstring).
+RECORD_ENCODING_EXPANSION = 2

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RecordLayout:
+    """A record is ``[num_slots, hidden_size]``:
+
+    * slot 0: the model output at the last prompt position (sampling).
+    * With a hidden-state drafter (EAGLE, EAGLE3, MTP, DFlash, DSpark), the
+      drafter's inputs for the last ``window`` prompt positions: the target
+      hidden states handed to the drafter, then each auxiliary layer's.
+      ``window`` is the drafter's prefill lookahead: 1, or k for k-module MTP.
+      Token-only drafters (ngram, draft model) need no drafter inputs.
+    """
+
+    hidden_size: int
+    # Prompt positions of drafter inputs stored (0: no hidden-state drafter).
+    window: int = 0
+    # EAGLE3 auxiliary hidden states per position.
+    num_aux: int = 0
+
+    @property
+    def num_slots(self) -> int:
+        return 1 + self.window * (1 + self.num_aux)
+
+    def drafter_slots(self, kind: int) -> slice:
+        """Slots of the drafter input ``kind`` (0: target hidden states,
+        1 + i: auxiliary layer i), ordered by position, last position last."""
+        start = 1 + kind * self.window
+        return slice(start, start + self.window)

+def get_record_layout(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> RecordLayout:
+    hidden_size = vllm_config.model_config.get_hidden_size()
+    spec_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    if spec_config is None or spec_config.use_ngram() or spec_config.uses_draft_model():
+        # The drafter reads only token ids (its own KV comes with the transfer).
+        return RecordLayout(hidden_size)
+    # Hidden-state drafters: EAGLE, EAGLE3, MTP (incl. multi-module and Gemma4),
+    # DFlash (incl. DFlash2/LiLiCorr), DSpark, and the hidden-state extractor
+    # (which reads only the auxiliary ones).
+    if not (spec_config.use_eagle() or spec_config.method == "extract_hidden_states"):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "P/D hidden-state handoff does not support "
+            f"{spec_config.method!r} speculative decoding."
+        )
+    num_aux = 0
+    if spec_config.method in ("eagle3", "dflash", "dspark", "extract_hidden_states"):
+        # The target model outputs auxiliary hidden states for these drafters
+        # (see GPUModelRunner.use_aux_hidden_state_outputs). The worker checks
+        # the count against the model's.
+        from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.eagle3_utils import (
+            get_eagle3_aux_layers_from_config,
+        )

+        aux_layers = get_eagle3_aux_layers_from_config(spec_config)
+        num_aux = len(aux_layers) if aux_layers else _DEFAULT_NUM_AUX_LAYERS

+    return RecordLayout(hidden_size, window, num_aux)

+def get_record_carrier_group(kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig) -> int:
+    """The transferred attention group whose blocks carry the record: the first
+    full-attention one (incl. MLA and R-SWA), else the first sliding-window
+    one. Its layers must keep one token per cache slot. Ring buffers and
+    compressed caches cannot carry: their slots past the prompt are in use."""
+    candidates: dict[type, int] = {}
+    for group_id in kv_cache_config.transfer_group_ids:
+        specs = iter_layer_specs(
+            kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups[group_id].kv_cache_spec
+        )
+        for kind in (FullAttentionSpec, SlidingWindowSpec):
+            if all(
+                isinstance(spec, kind) and spec.tokens_per_state == 1 for spec in specs
+            ):
+                candidates.setdefault(kind, group_id)
+    preference: tuple[type, ...] = (FullAttentionSpec, SlidingWindowSpec)
+    if os.environ.get("VLLM_HIDDEN_STATE_RECORD_CARRIER") == "sliding_window":
+        # Testing only: carry the record in a sliding-window group even when a
+        # full-attention group exists.
+        preference = preference[::-1]
+    for preferred in preference:
+        if preferred in candidates:
+            return candidates[preferred]
+    raise NotImplementedError(
+        "P/D hidden-state handoff needs a transferred full-attention or "
+        "sliding-window KV cache group."
+    )
+
+
+def _group_record_layers(kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """The carrier group's layers in ``kv_cache_config`` with the bytes one KV
+    head of one token slot holds."""
+    group = kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups[get_record_carrier_group(kv_cache_config)]
+    spec = group.kv_cache_spec
+    return {
+        name: (
+            spec.kv_cache_specs[name]
+            if isinstance(spec, UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs)
+            else spec
+        ).state_content_size_bytes
+        for name in group.layer_names
+    }
+
+
+def _layer_index(layer_name: str) -> int | None:
+    """A layer's index in the model, or None if its name has no single one."""
+    indices = [int(part) for part in layer_name.split(".") if part.isdigit()]
+    return indices[0] if len(indices) == 1 else None
+
+
+def get_record_producer_pp_size(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> int:
+    """The prefiller's pipeline-parallel size: this instance's own on P; on D,
+    ``kv_connector_extra_config["hidden_state_handoff_producer_pp_size"]``
+    (default 1). The prefiller keeps the records on its last stage, which has
+    the hidden states."""
+    kv_transfer_config = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+    assert kv_transfer_config is not None
+    if kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer:
+        return vllm_config.parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size
+    return int(
+        kv_transfer_config.get_from_extra_config(
+            "hidden_state_handoff_producer_pp_size", 1
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def resolve_record_layers(
+    vllm_config: VllmConfig, kv_cache_configs: list[KVCacheConfig]
+) -> tuple[tuple[str, int], ...]:
+    """The layers holding the record, resolved from the per-layer specs of every
+    worker (pipeline stage): the carrier group's layers on the prefiller's last
+    stage (all of them without PP), in model order, each with the bytes one KV
+    head of one token slot holds."""
+    layers: dict[str, int] = {}
+    for kv_cache_config in kv_cache_configs:
+        layers.update(_group_record_layers(kv_cache_config))
+    pp_size = get_record_producer_pp_size(vllm_config)
+    if pp_size > 1:
+        from vllm.distributed.utils import get_pp_indices
+
+        num_layers = vllm_config.model_config.get_total_num_hidden_layers()
+        start, end = get_pp_indices(num_layers, pp_size - 1, pp_size)
+        layers = {
+            name: size
+            for name, size in layers.items()
+            if (index := _layer_index(name)) is not None and start <= index < end
+        }
+        if not layers:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "P/D hidden-state handoff needs a carrier-group layer on the "
+                "prefiller's last pipeline stage."
+            )
+    return tuple(sorted(layers.items(), key=lambda item: _layer_index(item[0]) or 0))
+
+
+def get_record_layers(kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig) -> tuple[tuple[str, int], ...]:
+    """The layers holding the record, each with the bytes one KV head of one
+    token slot holds (see ``resolve_record_layers``, which the engine resolves
+    into the config; the scheduler's copy keeps one spec per group)."""
+    if kv_cache_config.hidden_state_record_layers:
+        return kv_cache_config.hidden_state_record_layers
+    # A config not built by the engine (e.g. in tests): no PP.
+    return tuple(_group_record_layers(kv_cache_config).items())
+
+
+def get_record_tail_tokens(
+    vllm_config: VllmConfig, kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig
+) -> int:
+    """Token slots past the prompt that hold the record."""
+    layout = get_record_layout(vllm_config)
+    record_bytes = (
+        layout.num_slots
+        * layout.hidden_size
+        * get_dtype_size(vllm_config.model_config.dtype)
+        * RECORD_ENCODING_EXPANSION
+    )
+    head_bytes = sum(size for _, size in get_record_layers(kv_cache_config))
+    return cdiv(record_bytes, head_bytes)
+
+
+# NIXL connectors the handoff is on by default for.
+_DEFAULT_CONNECTORS = ("NixlConnector", "NixlPullConnector", "NixlPushConnector")

+def _handoff_default_blockers(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> list[str]:
+    """Conditions, the same on the prefiller and the decoder, under which the
+    handoff is off by default (an explicit opt-in is checked later)."""
+    kv_transfer_config = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+    assert kv_transfer_config is not None
+    model_config = vllm_config.model_config
+    blockers = {
+        f"the {kv_transfer_config.kv_connector} KV connector": (
+            kv_transfer_config.kv_connector not in _DEFAULT_CONNECTORS
+        ),
+        f"kv_role {kv_transfer_config.kv_role}": (
+            kv_transfer_config.kv_role not in ("kv_producer", "kv_consumer")
+        ),
+        "pooling models": model_config is not None
+        and model_config.runner_type == "pooling",
+        # No attention KV to carry the record.
+        "attention-free models": model_config is not None
+        and model_config.is_attention_free,
+        "multimodal multi-module MTP": model_config is not None
+        and model_config.is_multimodal_model
+        and vllm_config.num_prefill_lookahead_tokens > 1,
+        # Unsupported, but configured alike on both sides in practice (a
+        # mismatch fails the NIXL handshake with a clear error).
+        "NIXL host buffers": kv_transfer_config.kv_buffer_device == "cpu",
+        "model runner V1": not vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner,
+    }
+    return [name for name, on in blockers.items() if on]
+

+def _handoff_unsupported(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> list[str]:
+    """Features the handoff does not support, errors with it on. The parallel
+    and HiSparse ones are configured on one side only, so they cannot turn the
+    default off without the other side disagreeing."""
+    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    kv_transfer_config = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+    assert kv_transfer_config is not None
+    unsupported = {
+        "decode context parallelism": (
+            parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size > 1
+        ),
+        "prefill context parallelism": (
+            parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size > 1
+        ),
+        # A prefiller keeps the records on its last stage (NIXL supports PP
+        # only there).
+        "pipeline parallelism on the decoder": (
+            parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size > 1
+            and not kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer
+        ),
+        "HiSparse": vllm_config.attention_config.hisparse_config is not None,
+        "NIXL host buffers": kv_transfer_config.kv_buffer_device == "cpu",
+        "model runner V1": not vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner,
+    }
+    return [name for name, on in unsupported.items() if on]
+

+def resolve_hidden_state_handoff(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+    """Resolve whether the P/D hidden-state handoff is on: as configured
+    (``kv_connector_extra_config["hidden_state_handoff"]``), else by default
+    wherever both the prefiller and the decoder can tell it is supported.
+    Raise for features it does not support while on."""
+    kv_transfer_config = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+    if kv_transfer_config is None or kv_transfer_config.kv_connector is None:
+        return
+    extra_config = kv_transfer_config.kv_connector_extra_config
+    explicit = "hidden_state_handoff" in extra_config
+    if not explicit:
+        extra_config["hidden_state_handoff"] = not _handoff_default_blockers(
+            vllm_config
+        )
+    if not kv_transfer_config.hidden_state_handoff:
+        return
+    if unsupported := _handoff_unsupported(vllm_config):
+        how = "is enabled" if explicit else "is on by default with NIXL"
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"The P/D hidden-state handoff {how} but does not support "
+            f"{', '.join(unsupported)}. Disable it on both the prefiller and "
+            "the decoder with "
+            '--kv-transfer-config \'{"kv_connector_extra_config": '
+            '{"hidden_state_handoff": false}}\'.'
+        )
+    logger.info_once(
+        "P/D hidden-state handoff enabled%s: the prefiller computes the whole "
+        "prompt and hands the decoder its last hidden states.",
+        "" if explicit else " (default)",
+    )
+

+def get_hidden_state_handoff_compat(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> int:
+    """What a prefiller and decoder must agree on: 0 with the handoff off,
+    else the prefiller's pipeline-parallel size (where the records live)."""
+    kv_transfer_config = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+    if kv_transfer_config is None or not kv_transfer_config.hidden_state_handoff:
+        return 0
+    return get_record_producer_pp_size(vllm_config)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""P/D hidden-state handoff (prototype).
+
+The prefiller (P) computes every prompt token and stores what the decoder needs
+from the last prompt positions in a per-request "record" (``RecordLayout``),
+kept in the request's own KV blocks: in the token slots just past the prompt of
+one full-attention cache group (see ``vllm.v1.core.hidden_state_record``). The
+KV connector transfers it with the blocks. The decoder (D) loads all prompt
+tokens plus the record and samples the first output token from it, without
+running a forward pass for any prompt position.
+
+The scheduler still accounts for the last prompt token as a one-token step
+(``SchedulerOutput.hidden_state_record_req_ids``), so the request's computed
+token count, sampling position (seeds) and token budget match a recompute. The
+model runner drops those rows from the forward batch and appends them, one
+token each, to the batch it samples from, with their hidden states read from
+the record.
+
+The drafter runs on a batch where each sample-only row covers the drafter's
+``window`` trailing prompt positions, so it rewrites its own KV for them with
+D's sampled token exactly as a local final prefill chunk would (P wrote them
+with its own sampled token and drafts). With a one-position window and an
+otherwise uniform decode batch, each sample-only row is padded with
+placeholder positions to a full decode row, rejected like the placeholder
+drafts of a recomputed row, so the drafter keeps its full CUDA graph.
+
+The record's slots are free while it lives there: P writes it at the end of the
+step that completes the prompt, after its drafter has written its own KV past
+the prompt, and the request then finishes; D reads it at the start of its
+sampling step, before that step's drafter or the next step's forward writes
+those slots.
+
+The sampling batch reuses the forward batch's tokens and appends one token per
+sample-only row. Prompt logprobs are assumed never to be requested on D.
+
+Records are gathered, written and read by Triton kernels that find the token
+slots from the block table, and the appended rows are written by one kernel
+into the forward batch's input buffers, so a step costs a handful of launches
+and one host-to-device copy.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn

+from vllm.config import VllmConfig

+logger = init_logger(__name__)

+# Fields per carrier layer in HiddenStateHandoff.layer_info.
+_LAYER_INFO_FIELDS = 7
+
+
+def _check_record_layout(
+    vllm_config: VllmConfig, model: nn.Module, layout: RecordLayout
+) -> None:
+    """The scheduler sizes the record from the config; check it against the
+    model's actual auxiliary hidden-state layers."""
+    if not layout.num_aux:
+        return
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.eagle3_utils import (
+        get_eagle3_aux_layers_from_config,
+    )
+
+    spec_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    assert spec_config is not None
+    aux_layers = get_eagle3_aux_layers_from_config(spec_config)
+    if not aux_layers:
+        aux_layers = model.get_eagle3_default_aux_hidden_state_layers()
+    if len(aux_layers) != layout.num_aux:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"P/D hidden-state handoff assumed {layout.num_aux} auxiliary "
+            f"hidden-state layers, but the model uses {len(aux_layers)}."
+        )
+

+def _aligned_offsets(sizes: list[int], element_size: int) -> list[int]:
+    """Offsets of consecutive segments of ``sizes`` elements, each starting
+    16-byte aligned, then the total length. Triton specializes kernels on
+    pointer alignment, so unaligned segments would compile new kernel variants
+    while serving, as batch sizes vary."""
+    step = 16 // element_size
+    offsets = [0]
+    for size in sizes:
+        offsets.append(offsets[-1] + -(-size // step) * step)
+    return offsets
+
+
+def _h2d_packed(parts: list[np.ndarray], device: torch.device) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+    """``parts`` as int64 device tensors, copied in one, each 16-byte aligned
+    (see ``_aligned_offsets``)."""
+    offsets = _aligned_offsets([len(p) for p in parts], 8)
+    packed = np.zeros(offsets[-1], dtype=np.int64)
+    for part, offset in zip(parts, offsets):
+        packed[offset : offset + len(part)] = part
+    packed_gpu = async_tensor_h2d(packed, device, torch.int64)
+    return [packed_gpu[o : o + len(p)] for p, o in zip(parts, offsets)]
+
+
+def _cat_rows(fwd: InputBatch | None, name: str, rows_value: Any) -> np.ndarray:
+    """The forward batch's per-request field ``name`` (zeros if unset), then
+    the sample-only rows' ``rows_value``."""
+    if fwd is None:
+        return rows_value
+    value = getattr(fwd, name)
+    if value is None:
+        value = np.zeros(fwd.num_reqs, dtype=rows_value.dtype)
+    return np.concatenate([np.asarray(value[: fwd.num_reqs]), rows_value])
+
+
+class HiddenStateHandoff:
+    """Writes records on P and samples (and drafts) from them on D."""
+
+    def __init__(self, runner: "GPUModelRunner", kv_caches: dict[str, torch.Tensor]):
+        vllm_config = runner.vllm_config
+        self.model = runner.model
+        self.kv_cache_config = kv_cache_config = runner.kv_cache_config
+        self.block_tables = runner.block_tables
+        self.req_states = runner.req_states
+        self.prompt_logprobs_worker = runner.prompt_logprobs_worker
+        self.model_state = runner.model_state
+        self.speculator = speculator = runner.speculator
+        self.input_buffers = runner.input_buffers
+        self.decode_query_len = runner.decode_query_len
+        self.max_model_len = runner.max_model_len
+        self.device = runner.device
+        kv_transfer_config = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+        assert kv_transfer_config is not None
+        # Only a prefiller hands records over.
+        self.saves_records = kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer
+
+        self.layout = layout = get_record_layout(vllm_config)
+        _check_record_layout(vllm_config, self.model, layout)
+        if (
+            isinstance(speculator, DraftModelSpeculator)
+            and speculator.supports_mm_inputs
+            and layout.window > 1
+        ):
+            # A one-token drafting window starts past the prompt, so it needs
+            # no encoder outputs; a longer one may cover media placeholders.
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Multimodal multi-module MTP drafters are not supported with "
+                "the P/D hidden-state handoff yet."
+            )
+        self.dtype = vllm_config.model_config.dtype
+        self.record_bytes = (
+            layout.num_slots * layout.hidden_size * get_dtype_size(self.dtype)
+        )
+
+        # The layers holding the record, as byte views [blocks, heads, tokens,
+        # bytes per head]. A token slot holds the record bytes, split over the
+        # layers, in each head. They are on the prefiller's last pipeline
+        # stage, which has the hidden states; earlier stages never touch them.
+        self.group_id = group_id = get_record_carrier_group(kv_cache_config)
+        self.tail_tokens = get_record_tail_tokens(vllm_config, kv_cache_config)
+        record_layers = get_record_layers(kv_cache_config)
+        layer_views = (
+            [kv_caches[name].view(torch.uint8) for name, _ in record_layers]
+            if runner.is_last_pp_rank
+            else []
+        )
+        self.head_bytes = sum(size for _, size in record_layers)
+        assert not layer_views or self.head_bytes == sum(
+            v.shape[-1] for v in layer_views
+        )
+        assert (
+            self.tail_tokens * self.head_bytes
+            >= self.record_bytes * RECORD_ENCODING_EXPANSION
+        )
+        # The views are in kernel blocks, which split the block table's.
+        block_size = self.block_tables.block_sizes[group_id]
+        kernel_block_size = runner.kernel_block_sizes[group_id]
+        if block_size % kernel_block_size or any(
+            v.shape[2] != kernel_block_size for v in layer_views
+        ):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "P/D hidden-state handoff needs one token per KV cache slot."
+            )
+        self._init_record_slots(
+            layer_views,
+            self.block_tables.block_tables[group_id].gpu,
+            block_size,
+            kernel_block_size,
+        )
+        logger.info(
+            "P/D hidden-state records: %d bytes in %d token slot(s) past the "
+            "prompt of KV cache group %d",
+            self.record_bytes,
+            self.tail_tokens,
+            group_id,
+        )
+
+        # Attention groups of the drafter's own layers, whose metadata the
+        # drafter's first step reuses from the target's forward.
+        self.draft_attn_groups: list[list[AttentionGroup]] | None = None
+        if isinstance(speculator, DraftModelSpeculator):
+            draft_layers = speculator.draft_attn_layer_names
+            self.draft_attn_groups = [
+                [g for g in groups if draft_layers.intersection(g.layer_names)]
+                for groups in runner.attn_groups
+            ]
+        # Whether sample-only rows may be padded to full decode rows for the
+        # drafter's full CUDA graph (see _plan_draft): a one-position window,
+        # and decode rows the scheduler pads alike (fixed draft counts).
+        spec_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
+        self.pads_draft_rows = (
+            isinstance(speculator, TargetDependentARSpeculator)
+            and layout.window == 1
+            and runner.dp_size == 1
+            and runner.adaptive_verification is None
+            and spec_config is not None
+            and not spec_config.uses_dynamic_speculative_decoding()
+        )
+        # Requests sampled from their record this step, in batch order, and
+        # their rows (with the loaded records) once read.
+        self.sample_only_req_ids: list[str] = []
+        self._rows: _SampleOnlyRows | None = None
+        # P: records of prompts this step completed, written into the KV cache
+        # at the end of the step: (request indices, prompt lengths, records).
+        self._pending: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None
+        self._no_padding = torch.zeros(
+            self.input_buffers.max_num_tokens, dtype=torch.bool, device=self.device
+        )
+        # Zero drafter inputs for the padding tokens of a CUDA graph.
+        self._zero_rows = torch.zeros(
+            0, layout.hidden_size, dtype=self.dtype, device=self.device
+        )
+
+    def _init_record_slots(
+        self,
+        layer_views: list[torch.Tensor],
+        block_table: torch.Tensor,
+        block_size: int,
+        kernel_block_size: int | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """What the record kernels need to find a record's token slots: the
+        carrier group's block table ``[max_num_reqs, max_num_blocks]``, its
+        block size and the layer views' (kernel) block size, and, per layer,
+        its byte view's address, block, head and token strides, number of
+        heads, bytes per head and their offset in a slot's record bytes."""
+        self.layer_views = layer_views
+        self.block_table = block_table
+        self.block_size = block_size
+        self.kernel_block_size = kernel_block_size or block_size
+        info, start = [], 0
+        for view in layer_views:
+            assert view.dtype == torch.uint8 and view.dim() == 4
+            assert view.stride(-1) == 1 and view.shape[-1] % 2 == 0
+            size = view.shape[-1]
+            info.append(
+                [view.data_ptr(), *view.stride()[:3], view.shape[1], size, start]
+            )
+            start += size
+        self.layer_info = torch.tensor(
+            info, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device
+        ).reshape(-1, _LAYER_INFO_FIELDS)
+        self.max_layer_bytes = max((v.shape[-1] for v in layer_views), default=0)
+
+    def _write_records(
+        self, req_idx: torch.Tensor, prompt_len: torch.Tensor, records: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> None:
+        """Store ``records`` ``[num_reqs, record_bytes]`` (bytes) past the
+        prompts of the requests at ``req_idx``, in every head of each layer."""
+        num_reqs = records.shape[0]
+        _write_records_kernel[(num_reqs, self.tail_tokens, len(self.layer_views))](
+            records,
+            req_idx,
+            prompt_len,
+            self.block_table,
+            self.block_table.stride(0),
+            self.layer_info,
+            self.record_bytes,
+            self.head_bytes,
+            self.block_size,
+            self.kernel_block_size,
+            BLOCK=triton.next_power_of_2(self.max_layer_bytes),
+        )
+
+    def _read_records(
+        self, req_idx: torch.Tensor, prompt_len: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The records ``[num_reqs, num_slots, hidden]`` past the prompts (from
+        head 0, which any TP rank holds a copy in)."""
+        num_reqs = req_idx.shape[0]
+        records = torch.empty(
+            num_reqs, self.record_bytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device=self.device
+        )
+        _read_records_kernel[(num_reqs, self.tail_tokens, len(self.layer_views))](
+            records,
+            req_idx,
+            prompt_len,
+            self.block_table,
+            self.block_table.stride(0),
+            self.layer_info,
+            self.record_bytes,
+            self.head_bytes,
+            self.block_size,
+            self.kernel_block_size,
+            BLOCK=triton.next_power_of_2(max(self.max_layer_bytes // 2, 1)),
+        )
+        return records.view(self.dtype).view(
+            num_reqs, self.layout.num_slots, self.layout.hidden_size
+        )
+
+    def begin_step(self, scheduler_output: SchedulerOutput) -> SchedulerOutput:
+        """Take the sample-only rows out of the batch the model runs."""
+        req_ids = scheduler_output.hidden_state_record_req_ids
+        self._rows = None
+        if not req_ids:
+            self.sample_only_req_ids = []
+            return scheduler_output

+        num_scheduled_tokens = {
+            req_id: n
+            for req_id, n in scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens.items()
+            if req_id not in req_ids

+            scheduler_output,
+            num_scheduled_tokens=num_scheduled_tokens,
+            total_num_scheduled_tokens=sum(num_scheduled_tokens.values()),
+        )

+    @property
+    def has_sample_only_reqs(self) -> bool:
+        return bool(self.sample_only_req_ids)

+    def prepare_sampling(
+        self,
+        input_batch: InputBatch | None,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor | None,
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] | None,
+        has_structured_output_reqs: bool,
+    ) -> tuple[InputBatch | None, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        """Save the records of prompts this step's forward completed (P), and
+        add the rows sampled from transferred records (D). ``input_batch`` is
+        None when no forward ran because every row is sample-only."""
+        if input_batch is not None and self.saves_records:
+            assert hidden_states is not None
+            drafter_hidden_states = None
+            if self.layout.window:
+                drafter_hidden_states = get_drafter_hidden_states(
+                    self.model, hidden_states
+                )
+            self._save(
+                input_batch, hidden_states, drafter_hidden_states, aux_hidden_states
+            )
+        if not self.has_sample_only_reqs:
+            return input_batch, hidden_states
+        rows = self._load_sample_only_rows(input_batch)
+        batch = self._sampling_batch(input_batch, rows, has_structured_output_reqs)
+        records = rows.records[:, 0]
+        if input_batch is None:
+            return batch, records
+        assert hidden_states is not None
+        return batch, torch.cat([hidden_states[: input_batch.num_tokens], records])

+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] | None,

+        if self.draft_attn_groups is not None:

+                draft_batch,
+                CUDAGraphMode.FULL if plan.full_cudagraph else CUDAGraphMode.NONE,
+            )
+        return (
+            draft_batch,
+            hidden_states,
+            aux,
+            attn_metadata,
+            slot_mappings_by_layer,
+            num_rejected,
+        )
+
+    def _zeros(self, num_rows: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self._zero_rows.shape[0] < num_rows:
+            self._zero_rows = torch.zeros(
+                triton.next_power_of_2(num_rows),
+                self.layout.hidden_size,
+                dtype=self.dtype,
+                device=self.device,
+            )
+        return self._zero_rows[:num_rows]
+
+    def _draft_attn(
+        self, draft_batch: InputBatch, cg_mode: CUDAGraphMode
+    ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        assert self.draft_attn_groups is not None
+        block_tables = self.block_tables.gather_block_tables(
+            draft_batch.idx_mapping,
+            num_reqs_padded=draft_batch.num_reqs_after_padding,
+        )
+        slot_mappings = self.block_tables.compute_slot_mappings(
+            draft_batch.idx_mapping,
+            draft_batch.query_start_loc[: draft_batch.num_reqs + 1],
+            draft_batch.positions,
+            num_tokens_padded=draft_batch.num_tokens_after_padding,
+        )
+        slot_mappings_by_layer = build_slot_mappings_by_layer(
+            slot_mappings, self.kv_cache_config
+        )
+        attn_metadata = self.model_state.prepare_attn(
+            draft_batch,
+            cg_mode,
+            block_tables,
+            slot_mappings,
+            self.draft_attn_groups,
+            self.kv_cache_config,
+        )
+        return attn_metadata, slot_mappings_by_layer
+
+    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- P side
+
+    def _save(
+        self,
+        input_batch: InputBatch,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        drafter_hidden_states: torch.Tensor | None,
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Stage the records of the prompts this step's forward completed."""
+        completes_prompt = input_batch.is_prefilling_np & (
+            input_batch.num_computed_prefill_tokens_np
+            + input_batch.num_scheduled_tokens
+            >= input_batch.prefill_len_np
+        )
+        # Only P/D prefills reserve the record's slots past the prompt.
+        num_reqs = input_batch.num_reqs
+        num_slots = (
+            self.block_tables.num_blocks.np[
+                self.group_id, input_batch.idx_mapping_np[:num_reqs]
+            ]
+            * self.block_size
+        )
+        completes_prompt[:num_reqs] &= (
+            num_slots >= input_batch.prefill_len_np[:num_reqs] + self.tail_tokens
+        )
+        rows = np.flatnonzero(completes_prompt)
+        if rows.size == 0:
+            return
+        logger.info_once("Saving P/D hidden-state records for completed prompts")
+        layout = self.layout
+        prompt_len = input_batch.prefill_len_np[rows]
+        # Token index of each completed prompt's last position.
+        query_start = input_batch.query_start_loc_np[rows]
+        last_token = (
+            query_start
+            + prompt_len
+            - 1
+            - input_batch.num_computed_prefill_tokens_np[rows]
+        )
+        # Slot 0's source, then (with a hidden-state drafter) each kind of
+        # drafter input, for the trailing window right-aligned in its slots.
+        sources = [hidden_states]
+        if layout.window:
+            # The scheduler keeps the final prefill chunk at least as long as
+            # the drafter's lookahead, and prefix-cache hits drop the trailing
+            # block.
+            first_token = last_token + 1 - np.minimum(prompt_len, layout.window)
+            assert (first_token >= query_start).all(), (
+                "The final prefill chunk does not cover the drafter's window."
+            )
+            assert drafter_hidden_states is not None
+            sources += [drafter_hidden_states, *(aux_hidden_states or ())]
+            assert len(sources) == 2 + layout.num_aux
+        n = len(rows)
+        # One copy: request indices, prompt lengths, last tokens, and each
+        # source's address and row stride in bytes.
+        source_info = np.empty((len(sources), 2), dtype=np.int64)
+        for i, source in enumerate(sources):
+            assert source.dtype == self.dtype
+            assert source.shape[-1] == layout.hidden_size and source.stride(-1) == 1
+            source_info[i] = source.data_ptr(), source.stride(0) * source.element_size()
+        req_idx, prompt_len_gpu, last_token_gpu, sources_gpu = _h2d_packed(
+            [
+                input_batch.idx_mapping_np[rows],
+                prompt_len,
+                last_token,
+                source_info.reshape(-1),
+            ],
+            self.device,
+        )
+        records = torch.empty(
+            n, self.record_bytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device=self.device
+        )
+        slot_bytes = layout.hidden_size * get_dtype_size(self.dtype)
+        block = 1024
+        _gather_records_kernel[(n, layout.num_slots, triton.cdiv(slot_bytes, block))](
+            records,
+            prompt_len_gpu,
+            last_token_gpu,
+            sources_gpu,
+            self.record_bytes,
+            slot_bytes,
+            WINDOW=max(layout.window, 1),
+            BLOCK=block,
+        )
+        # Written into the KV cache at the end of the step (finish_step).
+        self._pending = (req_idx, prompt_len_gpu, records)
+
+    def finish_step(self) -> None:
+        """P: store the records staged this step, now that the drafter has
+        written its own KV past the prompts."""
+        if self._pending is not None:
+            self._write_records(*self._pending)
+            self._pending = None
+
+    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- D side
+
+    def _load_sample_only_rows(self, fwd: InputBatch | None) -> "_SampleOnlyRows":
+        """The sample-only rows, with their records (read once per step,
+        before the step's drafter writes past the prompts)."""
+        req_ids = self.sample_only_req_ids
+        req_states = self.req_states
+        num_rows = len(req_ids)
+        idx_mapping_np = np.fromiter(
+            map(req_states.req_id_to_index.__getitem__, req_ids),
+            dtype=np.intp,
+            count=num_rows,
+        )
+        # The scheduled token is the last prompt token, already computed by P.
+        num_computed_np = req_states.num_computed_tokens_np[idx_mapping_np]
+        prefill_len_np = req_states.prefill_len.np[idx_mapping_np]
+        assert (num_computed_np + 1 == prefill_len_np).all()
+        if self.prompt_logprobs_worker is not None:
+            uses = self.prompt_logprobs_worker.uses_prompt_logprobs
+            assert not uses[idx_mapping_np].any(), (
+                "Prompt logprobs are not supported on a P/D decoder with the "
+                "hidden-state handoff."
+            )
+        logger.info_once("Sampling from transferred P/D hidden-state records")
+        plan = self._plan_draft(fwd, prefill_len_np)
+        # One copy: request indices and prompt lengths, then the draft plan's
+        # per-row token offsets and real (prompt) tokens, and each drafter
+        # token's record row and (per kind of input) slot.
+        parts = [idx_mapping_np, prefill_len_np]
+        if plan is not None:
+            parts += [
+                plan.cu_num_tokens_np,
+                plan.num_real_np,
+                plan.token_row_np,
+                plan.token_slot_np.reshape(-1),
+            ]
+        req_idx, prompt_len, *draft_parts = _h2d_packed(parts, self.device)
+        if plan is not None:
+            plan.cu_num_tokens, plan.num_real, plan.token_row, token_slot = draft_parts
+            plan.token_slot = token_slot.view(-1, len(plan.token_row_np))
+        self._rows = _SampleOnlyRows(
+            req_ids=list(req_ids),
+            idx_mapping_np=idx_mapping_np,
+            prefill_len_np=prefill_len_np,
+            req_idx=req_idx,
+            prompt_len=prompt_len,
+            records=self._read_records(req_idx, prompt_len),
+            draft=plan,
+        )
+        return self._rows
+
+    def _plan_draft(
+        self, fwd: InputBatch | None, prefill_len_np: np.ndarray
+    ) -> "_DraftPlan | None":
+        """How the drafter's batch covers the sample-only rows: each row's
+        ``window`` trailing prompt positions (fewer for shorter prompts), or,
+        when that makes the batch a uniform decode with a full CUDA graph, a
+        full decode row of its last prompt position and placeholders after it
+        (as for a recomputed row padded with placeholder drafts)."""
+        layout = self.layout
+        if not layout.window or self.speculator is None:
+            return None
+        num_rows = len(prefill_len_np)
+        num_real = np.minimum(prefill_len_np, layout.window)
+        num_tokens = num_real
+        num_fwd_reqs = fwd.num_reqs if fwd is not None else 0
+        num_fwd_tokens = fwd.num_tokens if fwd is not None else 0
+        num_reqs = num_fwd_reqs + num_rows
+        full_cudagraph = False
+        num_tokens_padded = num_reqs_padded = None
+        query_len = self.decode_query_len
+        cudagraph_manager = getattr(self.speculator, "prefill_cudagraph_manager", None)
+        if (
+            self.pads_draft_rows
+            and query_len > 1
+            and cudagraph_manager is not None
+            and (
+                fwd is None
+                or get_uniform_decode_token_count(
+                    num_fwd_reqs,
+                    num_fwd_tokens,
+                    int(fwd.num_scheduled_tokens[:num_fwd_reqs].max()),
+                    fwd.decode_graph_eligible,
+                )
+                == query_len
+            )
+            # Room for the placeholders and a sampled token, as the scheduler
+            # requires to pad a row.
+            and int(prefill_len_np.max()) + query_len <= self.max_model_len
+        ):
+            desc = cudagraph_manager.dispatch(
+                num_reqs, num_reqs * query_len, query_len, num_active_loras=0
+            )
+            if desc.cg_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL:
+                full_cudagraph = True
+                num_tokens = np.full(num_rows, query_len)
+                num_tokens_padded = desc.num_tokens
+                num_reqs_padded = desc.num_reqs
+        cu_num_tokens_np = np.zeros(num_rows + 1, dtype=np.int64)
+        np.cumsum(num_tokens, out=cu_num_tokens_np[1:])
+        total = int(cu_num_tokens_np[-1])
+        # Each drafter token's row and window position: the real tokens are the
+        # window's last ones, and placeholders repeat the last.
+        token_row_np = np.repeat(np.arange(num_rows), num_tokens)
+        local = np.arange(total) - cu_num_tokens_np[token_row_np]
+        real = num_real[token_row_np]
+        window_pos = layout.window - real + np.minimum(local, real - 1)
+        kinds = np.arange(1 + layout.num_aux)
+        token_slot_np = 1 + kinds[:, None] * layout.window + window_pos[None, :]
+        num_tokens_total = num_fwd_tokens + total
+        return _DraftPlan(
+            num_tokens_np=num_tokens.astype(np.int32),
+            num_real_np=num_real.astype(np.int64),
+            cu_num_tokens_np=cu_num_tokens_np,
+            token_row_np=token_row_np,
+            token_slot_np=token_slot_np,
+            full_cudagraph=full_cudagraph,
+            num_tokens_padded=num_tokens_padded or num_tokens_total,
+            num_reqs_padded=num_reqs_padded or num_reqs,
+        )
+
+    def _sampling_batch(
+        self,
+        fwd: InputBatch | None,
+        rows: "_SampleOnlyRows",
+        has_structured_output_reqs: bool,
+    ) -> InputBatch:
+        """The forward batch with the sample-only rows appended, one token and
+        logit each, its hidden state from the record."""
+        nb = len(rows.req_ids)
+        na = fwd.num_reqs if fwd is not None else 0
+        num_fwd_tokens = fwd.num_tokens if fwd is not None else 0
+        num_fwd_logits = fwd.logits_indices.shape[0] if fwd is not None else 0
+        num_reqs = na + nb
+        num_tokens = num_fwd_tokens + nb
+        num_logits = num_fwd_logits + nb
+
+        # Per-request and per-logit fields: [idx_mapping, query_start_loc,
+        # seq_lens, cu_num_logits, expanded_idx_mapping, expanded_local_pos].
+        sizes = [num_reqs, num_reqs + 1, num_reqs, num_reqs + 1, num_logits, num_logits]
+        offsets = _aligned_offsets(sizes, 4)
+        ints = torch.empty(offsets[-1], dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device)
+        (
+            idx_mapping,
+            query_start_loc,
+            seq_lens,
+            cu_num_logits,
+            expanded_idx_mapping,
+            expanded_local_pos,
+        ) = (ints[o : o + n] for o, n in zip(offsets, sizes))
+        logits_indices = torch.empty(num_logits, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)
+        self._append_rows(
+            fwd,
+            rows,
+            query_start_loc,
+            seq_lens,
+            num_reqs,
+            sampling_outputs=(
+                idx_mapping,
+                cu_num_logits,
+                logits_indices,
+                expanded_idx_mapping,
+                expanded_local_pos,
+            ),
+        )
+
+        # Under adaptive verification the forward batch's per-request
+        # boundaries are exact only on the GPU (query_start_loc,
+        # cu_num_logits); its CPU arrays are upper bounds, and stay so here.
+        steps = np.arange(1, nb + 1, dtype=np.int32)
+        trues = np.ones(nb, dtype=np.bool_)
+        num_computed_np = rows.prefill_len_np - 1
+        zero = np.zeros(1, dtype=np.int32)
+        query_start_loc_np = np.concatenate(
+            [fwd.query_start_loc_np[: na + 1] if fwd is not None else zero, steps]
+        )
+        query_start_loc_np[na + 1 :] += num_fwd_tokens
+        cu_num_logits_np = np.concatenate(
+            [fwd.cu_num_logits_np[: na + 1] if fwd is not None else zero, steps]
+        )
+        cu_num_logits_np[na + 1 :] += cu_num_logits_np[na]
+        num_draft_tokens_per_req = None
+        if fwd is not None and fwd.num_draft_tokens_per_req is not None:
+            num_draft_tokens_per_req = _cat_rows(
+                fwd, "num_draft_tokens_per_req", np.zeros(nb, dtype=np.int32)
+            )
+        max_query_len = None
+        if fwd is not None and fwd.max_query_len is not None:
+            max_query_len = max(fwd.max_query_len, 1)
+        return InputBatch(
+            req_ids=(fwd.req_ids[:na] if fwd is not None else []) + rows.req_ids,
+            num_reqs=num_reqs,
+            num_reqs_after_padding=num_reqs,
+            idx_mapping=idx_mapping,
+            idx_mapping_np=_cat_rows(fwd, "idx_mapping_np", rows.idx_mapping_np),
+            expanded_idx_mapping=expanded_idx_mapping,
+            expanded_local_pos=expanded_local_pos,
+            num_scheduled_tokens=_cat_rows(
+                fwd, "num_scheduled_tokens", np.ones(nb, dtype=np.int32)
+            ),
+            num_tokens=num_tokens,
+            num_tokens_after_padding=num_tokens,
+            num_draft_tokens=fwd.num_draft_tokens if fwd is not None else 0,
+            num_draft_tokens_per_req=num_draft_tokens_per_req,
+            query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
+            query_start_loc_np=query_start_loc_np,
+            seq_lens=seq_lens,
+            seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=torch.from_numpy(
+                _cat_rows(
+                    fwd,
+                    "seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound",
+                    rows.prefill_len_np.astype(np.int32),
+                )
+            ),
+            dcp_local_seq_lens=None,
+            num_computed_tokens_np=_cat_rows(
+                fwd, "num_computed_tokens_np", num_computed_np
+            ),
+            prefill_len_np=_cat_rows(fwd, "prefill_len_np", rows.prefill_len_np),
+            num_computed_prefill_tokens_np=_cat_rows(
+                fwd, "num_computed_prefill_tokens_np", num_computed_np
+            ),
+            is_prefilling_np=_cat_rows(fwd, "is_prefilling_np", trues),
+            has_prefill=True,
+            decode_graph_eligible=False,
+            input_ids=self.input_buffers.input_ids[:num_tokens],
+            positions=self.input_buffers.positions[:num_tokens],
+            is_padding=self._no_padding[:num_tokens],
+            logits_indices=logits_indices,
+            cu_num_logits=cu_num_logits,
+            cu_num_logits_np=cu_num_logits_np,
+            has_structured_output_reqs=(
+                has_structured_output_reqs
+                or (fwd is not None and fwd.has_structured_output_reqs)
+            ),
+            prompt_lens=None,
+            prefill_runs_as_decode_np=_cat_rows(
+                fwd, "prefill_runs_as_decode_np", trues
+            ),
+            max_query_len=max_query_len,
+        )
+
+    def _draft_batch(
+        self,
+        fwd: InputBatch | None,
+        rows: "_SampleOnlyRows",
+        sampling_batch: InputBatch,
+        num_rejected: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[InputBatch, torch.Tensor]:
+        """The batch the drafter proposes from: the forward batch plus the
+        sample-only rows as planned (``_plan_draft``), laid out in the input
+        buffers (which a full CUDA graph reads), and its rejected-token
+        counts, which count each row's placeholders."""
+        plan = rows.draft
+        assert plan is not None
+        nb = len(rows.req_ids)
+        na = fwd.num_reqs if fwd is not None else 0
+        num_fwd_tokens = fwd.num_tokens if fwd is not None else 0
+        num_reqs = na + nb
+        num_reqs_padded = plan.num_reqs_padded
+        num_tokens = num_fwd_tokens + int(plan.cu_num_tokens_np[-1])
+        num_tokens_padded = plan.num_tokens_padded
+        buffers = self.input_buffers
+        query_start_loc = buffers.query_start_loc[: num_reqs_padded + 1]
+        seq_lens = buffers.seq_lens[:num_reqs_padded]
+        draft_num_rejected = torch.empty_like(num_rejected)
+        self._append_rows(
+            fwd,
+            rows,
+            query_start_loc,
+            seq_lens,
+            num_reqs_padded,
+            rejected=(num_rejected, draft_num_rejected),
+        )
+
+        num_real_np = plan.num_real_np
+        so_num_computed = rows.prefill_len_np - num_real_np
+        query_start_loc_np = np.full(num_reqs_padded + 1, num_tokens, dtype=np.int32)
+        query_start_loc_np[: na + 1] = (
+            fwd.query_start_loc_np[: na + 1] if fwd is not None else 0
+        )
+        query_start_loc_np[na + 1 : num_reqs + 1] = (
+            num_fwd_tokens + plan.cu_num_tokens_np[1:]
+        )
+        seq_lens_np = np.zeros(num_reqs_padded, dtype=np.int32)
+        seq_lens_np[na:num_reqs] = so_num_computed + plan.num_tokens_np
+        if fwd is not None:
+            seq_lens_np[:na] = fwd.seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound[:na].numpy()
+        num_placeholders = plan.num_tokens_np - num_real_np.astype(np.int32)
+        so_runs_as_decode = (num_real_np == 1) & (so_num_computed > 0)
+        draft_batch = replace(
+            sampling_batch,
+            num_reqs_after_padding=num_reqs_padded,
+            num_scheduled_tokens=_cat_rows(
+                fwd, "num_scheduled_tokens", plan.num_tokens_np
+            ),
+            num_tokens=num_tokens,
+            num_tokens_after_padding=num_tokens_padded,
+            num_draft_tokens=(fwd.num_draft_tokens if fwd is not None else 0)
+            + int(num_placeholders.sum()),
+            num_draft_tokens_per_req=_cat_rows(
+                fwd, "num_draft_tokens_per_req", num_placeholders
+            ),
+            query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
+            query_start_loc_np=query_start_loc_np,
+            seq_lens=seq_lens,
+            seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=torch.from_numpy(seq_lens_np),
+            num_computed_tokens_np=_cat_rows(
+                fwd, "num_computed_tokens_np", so_num_computed
+            ),
+            num_computed_prefill_tokens_np=_cat_rows(
+                fwd, "num_computed_prefill_tokens_np", so_num_computed
+            ),
+            decode_graph_eligible=plan.full_cudagraph,
+            input_ids=buffers.input_ids[:num_tokens_padded],
+            positions=buffers.positions[:num_tokens_padded],
+            is_padding=self._no_padding[:num_tokens_padded],
+            prefill_runs_as_decode_np=_cat_rows(
+                fwd, "prefill_runs_as_decode_np", so_runs_as_decode
+            ),
+            max_query_len=self.decode_query_len if plan.full_cudagraph else None,
+        )
+        return draft_batch, draft_num_rejected
+
+    def _append_rows(
+        self,
+        fwd: InputBatch | None,
+        rows: "_SampleOnlyRows",
+        query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+        seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+        num_reqs_padded: int,
+        sampling_outputs: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] | None = None,
+        rejected: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Write the sample-only rows after the forward batch's: their tokens
+        into the input buffers after its real tokens, and the per-request (and
+        for sampling, per-logit) fields into the given tensors after a copy of
+        its own. One token per row for sampling, else as the draft plan says.
+        The rows past them up to ``num_reqs_padded`` are a CUDA graph's
+        padding."""
+        num_rows = len(rows.req_ids)
+        sampling = sampling_outputs is not None
+        draft = rows.draft
+        # Placeholder tensors for the inputs a launch does not read.
+        unused = rows.req_idx
+        if fwd is None:
+            num_fwd_reqs = num_fwd_tokens = num_fwd_logits = 0
+            fwd_inputs: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] = (unused,) * 7
+        else:
+            num_fwd_reqs, num_fwd_tokens = fwd.num_reqs, fwd.num_tokens
+            num_fwd_logits = fwd.logits_indices.shape[0]
+            fwd_inputs = (
+                fwd.query_start_loc,
+                fwd.seq_lens,
+                fwd.idx_mapping,
+                fwd.cu_num_logits,
+                fwd.logits_indices,
+                fwd.expanded_idx_mapping,
+                fwd.expanded_local_pos,
+            )
+        if sampling:
+            max_tokens = 1
+            cu_num_tokens = num_real = unused
+        else:
+            assert draft is not None and rejected is not None
+            max_tokens = int(draft.num_tokens_np.max())
+            cu_num_tokens, num_real = draft.cu_num_tokens, draft.num_real
+        block = 1024
+        num_copy_programs = triton.cdiv(max(num_fwd_reqs + 1, num_fwd_logits), block)
+        all_token_ids = self.req_states.all_token_ids.gpu
+        _append_rows_kernel[(num_copy_programs + num_rows,)](
+            rows.req_idx,
+            rows.prompt_len,
+            cu_num_tokens,
+            num_real,
+            all_token_ids,
+            all_token_ids.stride(0),
+            self.input_buffers.input_ids,
+            self.input_buffers.positions,
+            num_rows,
+            num_fwd_reqs,
+            num_fwd_tokens,
+            num_fwd_logits,
+            num_reqs_padded,
+            num_copy_programs,
+            *fwd_inputs,
+            query_start_loc,
+            seq_lens,
+            *(sampling_outputs or (unused,) * 5),
+            *(rejected or (unused, unused)),
